annotations.title: Move held posts to another time

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Moves one or many posts held for review ("move to Tuesday 10:00", "+1 day"). Moving never approves and nothing goes live. A post already booked at the platform answers vendor_booked; use update_scheduled_post. Needs `review` or `publish`. Agency plan.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/reviews/move.)

to.description: Exactly one of: { at: ISO-8601 }; { shiftDays, shiftMinutes? } from each post's own slot; { date: "YYYY-MM-DD", time?: "HH:mm", timeZone } that day, at `time` or each post's own time of day.

name: move_reviews
